subject: Weekly Exec Staff Update — Wins, Gaps & QBR Prep Checklist
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: leadership-distro@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly Exec Staff Update — Wins, Gaps & QBR Prep Checklist

Team — dropping the weekly exec snapshot early so we have time to fold items into the QBR packet. Short bullets below; please flag edits or ownership gaps by EOD tomorrow.

Wins
- Redwood Dedicated beta: two pilot customers (Orbit Analytics, LumenHealth) completed integration tests; first-week latency targets met on p100s.
- Observability: console trace sampling added to model routes; mean time to root-cause for token failures down 22%.
- Cost toolkit: initial batching suggestions rolled into docs; pilot customers report ~12% token cost reduction in early runs.

Emergent risks / Gaps
- Capacity: we have a potential p100 inventory shortfall for expected Q3 spikes; capacity plan needed from infra. (Jonas, assigning to you to sync with infra ops.)
- QBR packet: missing deterministic SLO examples per customer tier — customers want explicit p95/p99 numbers and fallback behavior.
- Security evidence: customer audits asking for recent SOC evidence and retention screenshots; security asked us to attach packet.

Asks / Actions
- Jonas: confirm capacity mitigation options and list trade-offs (cost vs latency) by Tue 7/10.
- Karthik: please add concrete p95/p99 numbers for Hosted and Dedicated in the metrics section; propose owners for the mitigation runbook.
- Laura: can we get exec-level summary bullets for the packet (2–3 lines each) for CFO and CTO audiences?
- Marissa: coordinate final packet packaging and sign-off; upload v2 to Drive and share link.

Attachments: QBR_packet_draft_v2.pdf (slides + appendix).

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Sr. Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Staff Update — Wins, Gaps & QBR Prep Checklist

Monica — thanks, flagged. Quick clarifications:

- Capacity: current allocation forecast shows a 38% gap for p100s in late Aug if customers use Dedicated at projected rates. Short-term options: 1) bring on extra GCP p100s (costly, available immediately), 2) enable burst to hosted (lower latency guarantees), 3) prioritize top-tier customers and throttle lower tiers.
- I'll draft a 1-page trade-off matrix and include an estimated monthly delta.

On SLO examples: do we want to show raw p95/p99 or normalized per-sequence-length buckets? My recommendation: both — give the execs the normalized view plus one customer-facing example for clarity.

I'll take ownership of capacity mitigation doc; target Tue 7/10 EOD for circulation.

Jonas
Director, Infrastructure
